items.title: Find the tipping point in event detection
items.hook: Many systems change gradually until one threshold causes a disproportionate shift. This prompt asks where that threshold might be.
items.experiment: Vary observation overlap and noise in a synthetic event-detection task. Measure missed events and false alarms.
items.question: How much can coordinated small instruments infer together?
items.caveat: Synthetic exercise; not an astronomical discovery.

lenses.task: Map the system boundary, key components, feedback loops and possible bottlenecks.
State one observation that would weaken this hypothesis. Identify a competing explanation.
Choose a control condition, change one variable, and define a measurable outcome before running the test.
